title: Plumeform hero with haloed frame
description: A near-black green hero: a huge centred extra-bold headline, slate lead and paper pill button over a soft teal glow, then a big 33px-radius frame (a tall phone shape on mobile, wide on desktop) ringed by a spinning honey-to-mint halo. Everything rises in on load; the frame grows as you scroll and runs over the next section's top edge.
notes: forces dark colours; the frame's placeholder is the theme's foreground (paper) colour
the frame overlaps the next block: follow it with a block that has top padding
CSS only: load keyframes, a spinning conic ring, and a scroll(root) timeline for the grow
